answer: Make reputation decay unless it is renewed by work that peers verify under a public seed. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand wallets for free, but keeping each one alive means paying fresh compute every epoch, so the swarm fades to umber like dead leaves. A ring that grades its own members gets caught when panel draws keep scattering them, and even a whisper of collusion in the overlap stats costs them locked stake. Honest agents find a haven because their cost per identity stays flat while attackers pay per fake.
